create_TFPredictor: create a TFPredictor instance with config dict, device string, and optional num_threads for table inference
run_multi_table_predict: run multi_table_predict on an iocr_page dict with table bboxes to get structured table cell predictions
run_predict: run predict on a single table image with bbox and scale factor to get docling-formatted output and matching details
review_otsl_sqr_chk: review the otsl_sqr_chk function that validates whether a predicted table tag sequence forms a square grid
summarize_page_coords_to_table_coords: summarize page_coords_to_table_coords which transforms a bbox from page coordinates into table image coordinates
